reason: The hypothesis synthesizes two distinct literature streams—sinter- and water-resistant Pt/HEO catalysts (P1, P5, P7) and entropy-driven self-regeneration (P8, P17)—and applies them to a new system: a near-equiatomic multi-principal-element automotive alloy catalyst. It proposes a single, integrated intervention (an ultrathin HEO overlayer) that none of the passages explicitly suggests for this catalyst class, linking the mechanisms of sintering resistance, poison suppression, and self-regeneration into one combined solution for automotive exhaust durability.
